chapter: Harlem, Redman's band and the Savoy
title: Lenox Avenue clubs: the Savoy, the Cotton Club and the Saratoga Club
summary: He names the clubs on Lenox Avenue, including the Saratoga Club tied to Jack Johnson.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: It was. They had a lot of clubs on Lenox Avenue.
The Savoy Ballroom, the Cotton Club, the Saratoga Club. I remember when the Saratoga Club used to be there.
That was down the street from the Savoy.
It stayed there for a long time. About 130 -- maybe 140th Street. Between 140th and 39th, around in there.
There was a prizefighter, Jack White or somebody, that used to be in there, was it?
Oh. I knew it was one of those clubs here.
